title: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship for Minorities
official_title: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities (Haryana)
administering_authority: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment / Higher Education Department, Government of Haryana (with Ministry of Minority Affairs, GoI)
beneficiary_groups: Notified Minority Students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
summary: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities in Haryana provides financial assistance covering admission/tuition fees and monthly maintenance allowances to students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 11 through Ph.D. with family income up to ₹2,00,000.

benefits.description: Admission and tuition fee coverage (up to ₹3,000 - ₹10,000 per annum depending on course level) plus monthly maintenance allowance for 10 months (₹230 - ₹1,200 per month depending on hosteller/day scholar status and course).
conditions: Must have secured at least 50% marks in the previous final examination
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000
Must not be receiving duplicate scholarship for the same course

rules.explanation: Applicant must be a permanent resident/domicile of Haryana.

application_steps.description: Visit the National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in) or Haryana Har-Chhatravratti portal.
Register with One Time Registration (OTR) and obtain application credentials.
Fill in the application form with personal, course, and institution details.
Upload scanned copies of marksheets, minority declaration, fee receipt, and income certificate.
Submit application for Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and State Nodal Officer (SNO) verification.
